projectDescription: A fast, full-featured web proxy with built-in games, apps, tab cloaking, and multiple proxy backends, designed to be self-hosted and deployed on a Node.js server.
keyFeatures: XOR URL encoding with per-build randomization
Built-in tab system with tab cloaking (about:blank masking)
Large built-in games and apps catalogue (300+ titles)
Optional HTTP Basic Auth password protection
Production build pipeline with JS obfuscation, HTML hardening, and CSS minification
Multiple UI themes (Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Nord, Synthwave, etc.)
GitHub Codespaces, Heroku, Koyeb, Render, and Docker deployment support
publicApiSurface: GET / — home page with proxy search bar
GET /gh-games/:path — proxied GitHub-hosted game asset endpoint
config.js { challenge, users } — password protection configuration
PORT environment variable — server listen port (default 8080)
pnpm start / npm run start — start the server
pnpm build / npm run build — run the production build pipeline
